answer: The hollow schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the dawn checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 53 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. Anyone wanting 87 effective identities must lock that capital for 53 epochs and keep it locked through every oasis audit. That is 24 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
